summary: The article provides a generally reliable overview of Paras Defence's Q4 FY26 results, with most key financial figures aligning with authoritative sources. However, there are minor discrepancies in some reported percentages and a significant difference in the reported net profit figure in one instance.

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue for Q4 FY26 increased by 60.6% year-on-year to ₹180.36 crores, while net profit surged by 86.7% year-on-year to ₹38.88 crores.
claims.note: Consolidated total income for Q4 FY26 was ₹180.36 crores, up 60.6% YoY. Net profit was ₹38.88 crores, up 86.7% YoY.

claims.claim: The company reported a consolidated revenue of ₹180.36 crores for the quarter ended March 2026, marking a significant 60.6% increase year-on-year (YoY) from ₹112.28 crores in Q4 FY25.
claims.note: Consolidated total income for Q4 FY26 was ₹180.36 crores, up 60.6% YoY from ₹112.28 crores in Q4 FY25.

claims.claim: On a quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) basis, revenue grew by 66.0% from ₹108.62 crores in Q3 FY26.
claims.note: Consolidated total income for Q4 FY26 was ₹180.36 crores, up 66.0% QoQ from ₹108.62 crores in Q3 FY26.

claims.claim: Profitability also saw a sharp ascent, with the net profit reaching ₹38.88 crores in Q4 FY26. This represents an impressive 86.7% YoY growth from ₹20.83 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, and a 130.7% QoQ growth from ₹16.85 crores in Q3 FY26.
claims.note: Net profit for Q4 FY26 was ₹38.88 crores, up 86.7% YoY from ₹20.83 crores in Q4 FY25, and up 130.7% QoQ from ₹16.85 crores in Q3 FY26.

claims.claim: The Profit Before Tax (PBT) stood at ₹48.44 crores, showing a remarkable 108.8% QoQ increase.
claims.note: PBT for Q4 FY26 was ₹48.44 crores, an increase of 108.8% QoQ.

claims.claim: The Earnings Per Share (EPS) for Q4 FY26 was ₹4.27, reflecting an 88.9% QoQ improvement, although it was a 12.7% decline YoY from ₹4.89 in Q4 FY25.
claims.note: EPS for Q4 FY26 was ₹4.27, reflecting an 88.9% QoQ improvement from ₹2.26, and a 12.7% decline YoY from ₹4.89 in Q4 FY25.

claims.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share for FY26 also reflects a healthy financial position and a commitment to shareholder returns.
claims.note: The board recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share of face value ₹5 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

article_title: Analyzing Paras Defence's Share Price Outlook for 3 Years
